title: Habits count capped at 366 on List page
body:
Hello, it looks like a new regression issue has been introduced recently. On the Habits List page, I have several goals that I’ve completed more than 600 times, but the list page shows the number as 366. It seems that 366 might be treated as a maximum value and cannot increase further.

However, when I open the habit details page, the number of completed goals is displayed correctly.

title: Scam

title: As shameful as it can get
body: First, they’d put a constant “Just For You” cell obscuring my UI, then they prevented me from adding new habits - all to unceremoniously make me subscribe, even though I paid for the full version of the app. That‘s a really shameful marketing, I’d never reach out for solution like that as a developer, thus I suggest staying away from ANYTHING this Developer offers. Grasp all, lose all.
author: Ghost of the Mountains

title: One star
body:
One star for an anti-consumer-centric approach. 

I bought the app a few years ago and it keeps offering me paid subscription. Now they put a pop up message about a promo on the main screen that I cannot remove. 

Encountering bugs all the time - e.g. when you open the app it shows you yesterday’s records under “Today”. And in spite of focusing on fixing similar issues they just add promotional content.

title: Problem with widget on Home Screen
body:
Dear team, 
There is problem with showing actual data on goals on iPhone Home Screen widget. 
For example if I have chosen that every week starts on Monday and today is Sunday and I have my goals met in 3 out of 4 (and it’s visible when I am in application), however when I look at widget it shows that no count out of 4 was met this week. Please explain how to solve this problem! It’s look like with every goal that I create. Thanks

title: Simple and effective
body: Great minimalistic app to track goals. One feature I’d like to suggest (doing it here because the typeform links from the app don’t work) is to be able to change the view from weekly to to monthly goals and so on by swiping. Right now the swipe changes the date which is totally unnecessary for me because if I want to check my progress from past dates I prefer to look at the charts anyway. It would be perfect if the user could control how swiping works. Cheers.
